name: Cranston Manor
source:
The player must invade a mansion that was occupied by a millionaire and steal the sixteen treasures that are inside of it.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cranston_Manor]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
玩家必须入侵一座被百万富翁占据的豪宅，并偷走里面的十六件宝藏。

[来自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cranston_Manor]维基百科[/url]]
